snippet.title: 🦊 Red Panda: The Quiet Path is now on Steam!
snippet.description:
A peaceful, cozy third-person adventure where you play as a red panda exploring a quiet forest.
No combat. No text. No rush — just nature, silence, and the journey.

🎋 Add to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3771270/Red_Panda_The_Quiet_Path/?beta=0
